parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
Ensures idempotency. Provide a unique ASCII token generated by your client. A new token is provided for each distinct request.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID is different for each request.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: Performs a dry run. Checks parameters, syntax, and quotas and limits, with no changes being made. Returns DryRunOperation if validation succeeds; otherwise returns an error.

- **false** (default): Sends the request. On success, returns a 2xx status and performs the operation.

parameters.name: IpamResourceDiscoveryDescription
parameters.description: The description of the resource discovery.

parameters.name: IpamResourceDiscoveryId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource discovery instance.

parameters.name: IpamResourceDiscoveryName
parameters.description: The name of the resource discovery.

parameters.name: RemoveOperatingRegion
parameters.description: The operating regions to remove from the resource discovery.
